t: The Nebo Einstein Flex 1500 is a compact, high-output LED headlamp, delivering a powerful 1500 lumens for brilliant hands-free illumination. Its robust IPX4 water-resistant and drop impact-resistant design makes it ideal for electricians in attics, plumbers in confined spaces, or tradespeople on outdoor construction sites. This versatile rechargeable headlamp features flex power, operating with an included Li-Ion battery or two CR123A batteries, ensuring continuous operation. Five light modes include dimmable high and low power, plus red light for preserving night vision. An adjustable elastic headband provides a comfortable, secure fit for sustained professional use.
